title: Gentle Head Compression
summary: The palms gently contact the sides of the head with very light even pressure.
instructions: Place the palms on the sides of the head.
Do not press the temples or ears.
direction: Static pressure through broad palm contact.
warning: Do not massage damaged or inflamed skin. Stop with dizziness, worsening headache, pain, or other unusual symptoms.
